newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCare down after earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCare down after earnings warning.

text.p: Shares of PacifiCare Health Systems Inc fell sharply Tuesday morning after the company said second quarter earnings would fall short of analysts' estimates.
Analysts said there was uncertainty over how severe the earnings shortfall would be.
"One of the main problems with the sotck right now is the company has not disclosed how much the shortfall will be," said Chicago Corp analyst Peter Costa.
Costa said he had reduced his 1997 earnings estimate for PacifCare to $4.25 per share from $4.85. In 1996 the company earned $4.35 per share.

"Uncertainty is probably the worst thing you can have with a stock," said Alex Brown analyst Eleanor Kerns. "They just said they expect to miss their quarter and will have more details later. That leaves people with no information to deal with."
Kerns said the stock could rebound when PacifiCare provides more details about the extent of the expected shortfall.
